steps.hardClue: Recapture two zones, defeat the armored enemy and unlock the upgrade machine.
steps.clue: Recapture both Wards, defeat the Oni and unlock Pack-a-Punch at the World Seed.

steps.hardClue: Build a three-part tactical device, then rescue the caged animal to obtain the Wonder Weapon.
steps.clue: Build the Maneki-Neko and rescue the Nekomata to obtain the Nekomancer.

steps.hardClue: Light eleven lanterns with the Wonder Weapon before time runs out, then investigate the spirit.
steps.clue: Light the eleven lanterns with the Nekomancer, then investigate the spirit in the War Room.

steps.hardClue: Recover a mask and kill masked enemies in the displayed order for three rounds.
steps.clue: Recover the Fox Mask and complete the three-round mask-wall sequence.

steps.hardClue: Shoot the moving mask at three locations to collect evidence.
steps.clue: Chase the Fox Mask and collect the three pieces of suspect evidence.

steps.hardClue: Complete four investigation branches to gather evidence.
steps.clue: Complete the accomplice, poison, Sake Cup and clock-and-banner investigations.

steps.hardClue: Match five pieces of evidence to their paintings, then solve the animal dial.
steps.clue: Match the evidence to the five paintings, then solve the Zodiac Dial.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the elite enemy by breaking its mask defenses.
steps.clue: Defeat the Onryo by destroying its masks when immune, then open the route to the volcano.

steps.hardClue: Capture the immune zones and attack the boss’s weak spots.
steps.clue: Capture the Oni flag zones, then attack Nyxara’s glowing weak points to defeat her.
